theme: Editorial Swiss Modern & High-Density Admin Hub
design_archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast Editorial Newspaper + Precision Dark Control Panel

typography.font_family_heading: Playfair Display, Cormorant Garamond, Georgia, serif
typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
hierarchy.h3_article_card: text-lg sm:text-xl font-serif font-bold leading-snug hover:text-red-700 transition-colors duration-200
hierarchy.body_main: text-base sm:text-lg leading-relaxed text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 font-sans
hierarchy.meta_labels: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-mono font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

public_homepage.hero_layout: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 border-b border-slate-200 pb-12 mb-12
public_homepage.hero_main_article: lg:col-span-8 flex flex-col justify-between group cursor-pointer
public_homepage.hero_sidebar: lg:col-span-4 flex flex-col space-y-6 lg:border-l lg:border-slate-200 lg:pl-8
public_homepage.category_section_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8 py-8
public_homepage.newspaper_masthead: border-b-4 border-slate-900 dark:border-slate-100 py-6 mb-8 text-center uppercase tracking-wider

admin_dashboard.container: min-h-screen bg-[#0B0F17] text-slate-100 font-sans p-6 sm:p-10
admin_dashboard.stats_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-8
admin_dashboard.table_container: rounded-lg border border-slate-800 bg-[#111827] shadow-xl overflow-hidden

watermark_overlay.description: Visual indicator on public and preview media items showing official publication seal.
watermark_overlay.css_classes: absolute bottom-3 right-3 px-3 py-1 bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-md text-white font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-widest border border-white/20 rounded shadow-lg flex items-center gap-1.5 pointer-events-none select-none z-10

publish_action_button.description: Primary action button in admin table for Rewritten_Pending_Publish items.
publish_action_button.css_classes: inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-medium text-xs rounded-md shadow-md transition-all transform active:scale-95 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-400 focus:outline-none

public_navigation.description: Sticky top bar with blurred background, news categories, search & admin portal toggle.
public_navigation.css_classes: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#FDFCF7]/90 dark:bg-[#0B0F17]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JS React components (.js file extension) as specified by workspace conventions.
Implement both the public editorial news website experience and the sleek admin dashboard.

The 'Publish' action button on 'Rewritten_Pending_Publish' articles in the admin dashboard MUST transition the article status to 'Published', trigger a Sonner toast notification, and immediately display the article on the public homepage.
Render watermarked media badges on all published news photos on both public portal and admin preview.
Always ensure data-testid attributes are included on all interactive buttons, badges, links, and forms.
